description: Release TOOLING only. Library dependencies in deno.json (zod, date-fns, currency.js, ...) change what api-cloudrun, manager and templates receive, so bumping one is a release decision, not upkeep — they stay off, as in the consumer repos' configs.
Commits are chore(ci), which semantic-release treats as no-release, so merging a Renovate PR into beta does not cut a beta.

customManagers.description: The exact semantic-release pins in publish.yaml's `npm install -g` list.
The Deno CLI that runs checks and `deno publish`.

packageRules.description: Held at 9.3.1 on purpose — see the comment above the install step in publish.yaml. Its 10.x line drags the floating @conventional-changelog/template chain back in, which broke every publish on 2026-08-18. Re-enable only together with a release-notes-generator that has moved to conventional-changelog-writer@9.
One PR for the semantic-release stack: its plugins are pinned to be compatible with each other.
